Subject. PRO - JAPANESE AND ANTI - BRITISH ATTITUDE OF COMMANDER L. MEYRONE
AT ITALIAN CONSUL - GENERAL.
Made by. D.S.I. Malrevsky Forwarded by.
From sources close to Commander L. Meyrone, Italian
Consul - General and Senior Consul it has been learned
that the friendly relations which have always existed
between the Consul and Mayor Fu Siao En of the Greater
Shanghai Municipality and the Japanese authorities are
now becoming more and more close. Several large private
receptions have recently taken place at Commander
Meyrone's Residence at 73 Great Western Road at which
Mayor Fu Siao En and his Japanese entourage were present.
Commander Meyrone in turn has also paid several visits
to Mayor Fu at Kiangwan.
Commander Meyrone has been heard on several
occasions to remark that the time has come for the
British to cede their rights and privileges to the
Japanese and that the gradual increase of Japanese
influence in Shanghai will be beneficial to all who are
genuinely interested in the establishment of a unified
civic control and the resulting progress of Shanghai.
As regards the Extra-Settlement Roads Commander
Meyrone fully supports the claim of Mayor Fu to their
retrocession to the control of the Greater Shanghai
Municipality. He is also of the opinion that the taxes
in the western area should be collected by the Greater
Shanghai Municipality.
D.C. ( Special Branch ).

事由：关于意大利总领事 L. Meyrone 指挥官的亲日及反英态度。
制作人：D.S.I. Malrevsky 转呈人：
据接近意大利总领事兼资深领事 L. Meyrone 指挥官的消息来源获悉，该领事与大上海特别市政府市长傅筱庵以及日本当局之间一直存在的友好关系，正变得日益密切。近期，在位于大西路 73 号的 Meyrone 指挥官寓所举行数次大型私人招待会，傅筱庵市长及其日本随员均曾出席。Meyrone 指挥官也多次前往江湾拜访傅市长。
有人多次听到 Meyrone 指挥官表示，英国将其权利和特权移交给日本的时机已经到来，并且日本在上海影响力的逐步增强，将有利于所有真正关心建立统一市政管理并由此推动上海进步的人士。
关于越界筑路问题，Meyrone 指挥官完全支持傅市长要求将这些道路的管理权交还大上海特别市政府的主张。他还认为，西区的税款应由大上海特别市政府征收。
特别股副督察长（D.C.）。
